openrouter-api-key.label: OpenRouter API key
openrouter-api-key.helpText: OpenAI-compatible meta-provider. Used for AI tagging + sentiment. Encrypted at rest. Get one at openrouter.ai/keys.

llm-model.label: OpenRouter model slug
llm-model.helpText: Model identifier (e.g. anthropic/claude-haiku-4.5, openai/gpt-5-mini, google/gemini-2.5-flash). Defaults to claude-haiku-4.5 if blank.

llm-monthly-cost-cap-cents.label: Monthly LLM cost cap (USD cents)
llm-monthly-cost-cap-cents.helpText: Hard limit on AI spend per calendar month per installation. When exceeded, falls back to lexicon-only. Default $5.00 = 500 cents.

studio-bridge-enabled.label: Enable Studio webapp bridge (deprecated)
studio-bridge-enabled.helpText: Forwards events to studio.sub-vitals.app. Disabled by default — the domain is pending Reddit gateway approval, so calls will fail until approved. Leave OFF unless you've been told otherwise.

auto-reports-enabled.label: Auto-report posts with each pipeline verdict
auto-reports-enabled.helpText: When ON (default), SubVitals attaches one report line per pipeline signal (Intent, Sentiment, Spam, Fraud, PII, Impostor). Reports appear inline in the native Reddit "Reported" queue — mods see each verdict without opening the post. Turn OFF if you don't want bot reports cluttering your queue.

agent-whitelist.label: Verified agent usernames
agent-whitelist.helpText: One username per line. Pre-seeds the agent list on install.

taxonomy-json.label: Custom issue taxonomy (JSON)
taxonomy-json.helpText: Optional JSON array of {id,label,color}. Leave blank for defaults.

sentiment-threshold.label: Negative thread alert threshold
sentiment-threshold.helpText: Number of negative comments in a thread before mods get a modmail alert.

sla-minutes.label: First-response SLA (minutes)
sla-minutes.helpText: Posts unanswered by a verified agent beyond this threshold appear in the SLA breach feed.

routing-json.label: Per-driver routing rules (JSON)
routing-json.helpText: Optional JSON map of driverId → { subject?, mentions?: [usernames] }. When a post is auto-tagged with that driver, modmail fires once per post with title + URL + sentiment + reasoning, mentioning the listed users. Example: {"bug": {"subject": "[ENG] new bug post", "mentions": ["dev-alice"]}, "billing": {"mentions": ["finops"]}}

brand-voice.label: Brand voice for AI response drafts
brand-voice.helpText: Free-form note describing your brand's tone of voice. Used by the "Draft reply" feature to shape candidate replies. e.g. "Friendly, empathetic, never defensive. Acknowledge the user's frustration first. Avoid corporate-speak. Sign off as the Sonos community team."

brand-name.label: Brand name (for impostor detection)
brand-name.helpText: The brand or company name customers mention, e.g. "Sonos". Used to detect impersonation: comments from non-verified users claiming "I work at Sonos / I'm from Sonos support / as a Sonos engineer" get flagged for mod review. Leave blank to disable impostor detection.

agent-flair-pattern.label: Verified-agent flair pattern (regex)
agent-flair-pattern.helpText: Optional regex that matches your subreddit's official agent flair text. Anyone commenting with a flair matching this is automatically treated as a verified agent. Mod-controlled flair is the standard Reddit way to mark brand employees. Example: ^(Verified|Sonos Team|Brand Employee)$

agent-flair-text.label: Verified-agent flair text to apply
agent-flair-text.helpText: When a mod marks a comment author as a verified agent, SubVitals also applies this Reddit user flair so everyone in the sub can see who's official. e.g. "Sonos Team" or "Verified Agent". Leave blank to skip the flair sync.

agent-flair-color.label: Verified-agent flair background color
agent-flair-color.helpText: Hex color for the verified-agent user flair background, e.g. #1e3a8a. Defaults to a dark blue.
